summary: Server one-frame script command: switch an entity's Anubis (AI behaviour) config to the named one; consumed by the per-frame update of ls::anubis::ConfigSystem together with ls::anubis::ConfigComponent. Counterpart of esv::osiris::ChangeAnubisConfigRequestOneFrameComponent (SE: STDString Config). Never seen alive.

fields.name: Config
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3863AE0 (per-frame update of ls::anubis::ConfigSystem) walks the added rows of the query <ScriptCmdChangeAnubisConfigOneFrameComponent, ConfigComponent> with stride 0x18 and copies each one with ls::STDString::STDString(char*) into the first STDString of the ConfigComponent row (inline buffer when capacity +0x14 <= 0xF, else the heap pointer at +0). Registry size 24 = one LS string. Name as SE's esv::osiris::ChangeAnubisConfigRequestOneFrameComponent::Config.
